about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, 3.4B active, thinking) UD-Q4_K_XL on llama.cpp Metal at the full 131,072-token window, one slot, on a 32 GB Apple M1 Max with the default GPU memory limit (no sysctl change). llama.cpp is Unsloth's prebuilt b12588-mix-c0c3de8 (macOS arm64): mainline ggml-org llama.cpp does not run these quants correctly until ggml-org/llama.cpp#32704 merges. 128K fits in the 25.0 GiB Metal working set only with q8_0 KV and -ub 256: at the default -ub 512 the compute buffer is 6.1 GiB, and f16 KV (4.0 GiB) with -ub 256 still runs out of memory at warmup. No DSpark drafter: on this machine every draft length (1, 2, 3) decoded slower than no draft against interleaved controls, because each verified token routes to its own 8 experts in all 48 looped layer passes. --cache-ram 0 keeps llama-server's host prompt cache from adding memory pressure on a 32 GB machine. Thinking Machines' recommended sampling. Text only (no vision projector).
setup: macOS on Apple silicon with 32 GB or more. Unpack the archive into llama-b12588-mix-c0c3de8/ next to models/ and run from that directory. The launch uses about 23 GiB of the 25 GiB Metal working set; quit other GPU-heavy apps first.
